content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Boise

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires specific education and project-management experience to sit for the PMP exam. Review PMI's eligibility criteria—which combine formal education with verifiable work hours leading projects or teams. Granite PM Academy's advisors can clarify whether your background meets the standard, so you know before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP training course. Our Boise-based instructors deliver the PMI-required contact hours over a flexible schedule, covering the PMBOK Guide framework, real-world case studies, and exam strategy. You'll interact directly with instructors and peers throughout the program—no self-paced recordings.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your 35 contact hours, file your official PMP application with PMI. You'll provide proof of your education, project experience, and course completion. Pay the associated exam fee to PMI at this stage. Granite PM Academy staff will guide you through the online application process and document submission.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides targeted exam-preparation support—practice questions, mock exams, and review sessions—to reinforce PMBOK concepts and build test confidence. You'll schedule your computer-based PMP exam through Pearson VUE at a testing center or at home. Sit for the exam knowing you've had hands-on instruction, not just e-learning materials.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After passing the PMP exam, you hold the credential for three years. During that cycle, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) by attending training, conferences, volunteering in project-management roles, or publishing. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PDU-eligible workshops to help Boise professionals stay current and maintain their certification status.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.

PMP-certified professionals typically command measurable compensation premiums over non-certified peers, and the credential meaningfully strengthens your competitiveness in Boise's tight job market for senior project management roles.
